image_description: A close-up photograph of a bright orange coral fungus (Ramaria species) growing on a forest floor covered in pine needles and moss. The fungus exhibits a complex, multi-branched structure rising from a central base, with numerous cylindrical branches dividing into finer tips. The color is a vivid orange-yellow, consistent with the class description. The background consists of blurred brown pine needles and green moss, providing natural context.
